title: A certified classical-strip comparison for the de Bruijn-Newman constant
summary: We give a directed comparison beginning with the classical zero strip \(\lvert\Ima z\rvert\le1\) for the de Bruijn--Newman heat deformation. Under explicitly stated complete model-to-function source, localisation and global contact premises, translated-probe estimates imply \[ Λ\le\frac{148611789321711}{10^{15}} =0.148611789321711<0.148612. \] The construction uses Raymond's finite source data and 57 fixed translated kernels, independently checked by rational Bernstein certificates.
